jp: <STBG 5,0><BGM 0,0,504><MWT 2>On Adopo Hill I saw a stone monument.

<MWT 2>A picture of a hunter is
drawn upon it.

<MWT 2>I wonder if that monument
aided hunters of ancient times.
Could it really be a discovery!?
Anyway, I must go and report to the doctor!

<STBG 2,2><CHAR 1,2,1,0,0><CHAR 5,7,0,0,0><STBG 3,1><CHAR 1,1,1,2,0><CHAR 5,1,5,0,0><BGM 1,0,503><BGM 0,0,502><CV 1,5>Dr. Hawk!
I found a monument I've never seen,
so I came to report it!

<TALK 5><NAME 6><CV 3,2>Eliza!
Good of you to come. Let me see.

This is...
a picture of a hunter is drawn on it.

And this hollow...
this is, perhaps, from the old texts...

Yes, it must be the
<COL C70101FF>≪Ancient Stele of Growth≫</COL>...

To think it truly exists...
Oh, I've had a good idea!

As thanks for the discovery,
I'll have the guild send you something.

<COL C70101FF>Try it on the <COL C70101FF>Ancient Stele of Growth</COL>.
It should surprise you!

If you keep showing me new finds,
I'll send the same each time.

Right, I'll inform the other doctors.
Creatures to me, minerals to Dr. Sharon,
anything else to Dr. Andra.
